name: afterpull
description: After git pull, merge, checkout or rebase, lists what you need to run: reinstall dependencies (npm ci, poetry, uv, go, cargo, bundle, composer), apply new migrations, add new .env keys, rebuild containers, switch toolchains, update submodules, terraform init. One panel, one click per command, nothing runs on its own.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: AfterPull runs git inside the repository to see what changed and can start the suggested commands as tasks. It does nothing in an untrusted workspace and starts once the workspace is trusted.

chore.description: Internal key of the AfterPull chore this task belongs to.

afterpull.enabled.description: Watch every repository in the workspace for HEAD moves (pull, merge, checkout, rebase) and list what to run afterwards.

afterpull.notify.description: Show a notification when a HEAD move produces new chores.

afterpull.ignore.description: Repository-relative globs that are never considered, for example ["examples/**", "docs/**"]. A pattern without a slash matches the file name anywhere.

afterpull.disabledChores.description: Chore codes to turn off, for example ["AP010"].

afterpull.commands.description: Replace a suggested command. Keys are tool names (npm, yarn, pnpm, bun, poetry, uv, pip, pipenv, go, cargo, bundler, composer, django, alembic, prisma, rails, knex, flyway, migrate, docker, dockerBuild, submodules, terraform) or chore codes (AP001...). Example: {"npm": "npm install", "docker": "docker compose -f compose.dev.yml up -d --build", "migrate": "make migrate"}. The value is run as a shell command line in the chore's folder.

command.description: Shell command line to suggest, for example "make proto".

label.description: Text shown in the AfterPull view.

cwd.description: Run in the repository root (default) or in the folder of the changed file.

when.description: Match any change (default) or only newly added files.

afterpull.rules.description: Your own after-pull chores (AP013). Example: [{"glob": "proto/**/*.proto", "command": "make proto", "label": "Regenerate protobuf code"}].
